title: Wintergirls
author: Laurie Halse Anderson
summary: Lia, a teenager battling anorexia, is haunted by the death of her former best friend Cassie, and her grip on recovery weakens as she is pulled further into secrecy and self-destruction.
readIf: you want an unflinching, lyrical teen novel about eating disorders and grief.
skipIf: you are sensitive to detailed portrayals of anorexia and self-harm.
